trade_search_cycler.compact: Toggle book search. Lower GUI scale to display the catalogue beside trading.
trade_search_cycler.help.idle: Select a book and its exact level to start searching.
trade_search_cycler.help.searching: Waiting for each server response before the next attempt.
trade_search_cycler.help.found: The book is available. Searching has stopped.
trade_search_cycler.help.cancelled: No more attempts will be sent. A request already sent may still complete.
trade_search_cycler.help.blocked: Empty the trade input slots. The villager must support Trade Cycling and must not have traded before.
trade_search_cycler.help.timeout: The server did not reply within 10 seconds. Select the book to retry.
trade_search_cycler.help.unavailable: This enchantment can no longer be traded with villagers.
